 The State of Bihar

 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Sanjay Kumar S.K.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Anant Kumar 1
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice S. B. Pd. Singh
 Oral Order
3 10-02-2025
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned App for the State.

2. The instant application for anticipatory bail has been filed by the petitioner apprehending his
arrest in conne
ction with Mithanpura P.S. Case no. 195 of 2023 instituted for the offence under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Prosecution case relates to commission of irregularities by way of affixing of the Bar Code in answer sheets of intermediate Examination, 2023 by secrecy persons for getting more marks.
Allegedly, petitioner is one of the beneficiaries.

4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.84714 of 2024(3)
dt.10-02-2025 petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
She was not present at the place, where Bar Code was being affixed, at the alleged time of evaluation of copies.
She was nowhere responsible for affixing the Bar Code sticker in answer-sheets.
She has got no criminal antecedent.
5. Learned APP appearing for the State has opposed the prayer of Bail.
6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case as stated above, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

The petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within a period of four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest Sangita Kumari @ Sangita Devi vs The State Of Bihar on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56609103/
